hypothesis: The US HY OAS widening rule reduces extreme losses and drawdown in a predefined 20-ECB-fixing long-only FX momentum baseline, beyond constant lower exposure; it may not improve returns and is not a universal FX directional predictor.

sources.fx_reference: Official ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates; not executable
sources.vix: FRED VIXCLS (Cboe VIX close), descriptive context only
sources.availability_rule: Acquire all source observations during actual future capture; preserve timestamp, source observation dates and raw values; never substitute current vintage for past capture

time.macro_and_fx_cutoff: At capture instant all reported inputs must be already fetched and source FX latest must equal capture date
time.hy_rule: Exclude current or future US observations, then use the second-most-recent valid US HY daily observation before Rome capture date, paired with the observation five valid US dates earlier
time.vix_rule: Most recent VIX US close dated strictly before Rome capture date, optional/record-only

signal.baseline: For each pair: long 1 unit if ECB FX cross at capture T0 exceeds cross 20 ECB fixing sessions earlier, otherwise cash
signal.filtered: Identical baseline, but position=0 when lagged HY five-session widening >=10 bp
signal.cross_definition: For BASE/QUOTE, ECB quote-per-EUR divided by ECB base-per-EUR
signal.primary_direction: Long-only, no short or automatic reverse

outcome.entry: First ECB FX fixing session STRICTLY AFTER T0
outcome.exit: Second ECB FX fixing session STRICTLY AFTER T0
outcome.tracking: Record gross reference return separately from model reference PnL; 5 bps assumed per unit of changing exposure including initial entry; no carry/swap, slippage or executable price

controls.incomplete_source_policy: Append dated ABSTAIN snapshot; do not backfill or silently omit a scheduled trial day
controls.cohort_reanalysis: Treat correlated pairs and calendar days as a cluster, not independent events
benchmarks: constant scaling of momentum to the prospective filter's exposure, scale locked only after a training-free monitoring threshold; no retroactive optimizing
